source.source_name: GSXT — National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
source.attribution: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (SAMR)

parsing.notes: Real-name authentication + CAPTCHA gated per-company search; no open API/bulk; often HTTP 521 externally. Do NOT bypass the controls or scrape. USCC = company id = taxpayer id. Redact legal-representative name (PIPL). Mind cross-border data-export rules.

mapping_rules.company_id: Use USCC (统一社会信用代码).
mapping_rules.vat_id: Not available (no separate VAT number; taxpayer id = USCC).
mapping_rules.status: Map 登记状态: 存续/在营->active, 注销->deregistered, 吊销->revoked.
mapping_rules.officers: Legal representative only (法定代表人; redact PII).

fixture_requirements: documented-only: active LLC (有限责任公司)

live_test_plan.smoke: Not applicable — real-name + CAPTCHA gated; per-company manual lookup only.
live_test_plan.full: Not applicable for bulk — use a licensed commercial provider (cn_aggregators).

blockers: Per-company search requires real-name authentication + CAPTCHA; no open API or bulk.
No open re-use licence; legal-representative name is personal data (PIPL); cross-border data-export rules apply.
